messages.subject: [Sorvi-admin] Announcing Dropbox Links - The best way to share your stuff, ever.
messages.subject_clean: [Sorvi-admin] Announcing Dropbox Links - The best way to share your stuff, ever.
messages.body_plain:
Dropbox Links let you share files or folders (of any size) with anyone, even if they're not using Dropbox

Check it out at
http://www.dropbox.com/el/?r=/links/features&b=clk:72636380:10311965590801739494:1257:631&z=AACdSCI6Fw7TsjRoBvJAmKrYb2iHGRd150qttDd5bSncAw

Sharing files is a huge pain - you have to compress, attach, upload, and a bunch of other verbs that are a waste of your time. Forget that! We just invented the best way to get stuff from your computer to the rest of the world.

Happy Dropboxing!
- The Dropbox Team


___________________________________________________
If you prefer not to receive Dropbox newsletters, please go to https://www.dropbox.com/el/?r=/p/42709272045/171/174/AAACVFd_DjEezu5gmVWnrj3m6a0cK7ofoBqGuHIVZMxsoQ&b=clk:72636380:10311965590801739494:1257:631&z=AADr1DLmmyEYCduCw6CCgFd7btcVonkhQCgcqLeEqzT-ww
Dropbox, Inc., PO Box 77767, San Francisco, CA 94107
